description: Calculate travel distances and durations between sets of origins and destinations.

destinations.description: Non-empty array of destination addresses or place strings to calculate distances and durations to.

mode.description: Optional travel mode for the calculations: one of 'driving', 'walking', 'bicycling', or 'transit'.

origins.description: Non-empty array of origin addresses or place strings to calculate distances and durations from.

name: maps_distance_matrix
